extraction.Name: Emma Weber
extraction.Tribe/Reservation: Shannon County, South Dakota (Pine Ridge area)
extraction.Refused/Protested: while she did not make application for the patent in fee to her 632.16 acre allotment when it was issued, April 13,1918, she was perfectly willing to accept it when it was sent to her; and has never regretted it
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: in 1923, she mortgaged it, together with the quarter allotments of her three children, Frank, Joseph and Julia, for the sum of $7000.00, mortgage in favor of the Federal Loan Association, of Omaha, Nebraska
extraction.Buyer: Federal Loan Association, of Omaha, Nebraska, for $7000.00
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: she did not sell her land for any debts incurred prior to receiving her patent in fee; mortgage was taken in order for her husband to buy three whole sections of land; she has kept the interest paid up on this loan, and expects to pay this mortgage off this coming fall, when her husband sells his stock, thus clearing her land
extraction.Occupation/Income: her husband, who has fine health, supports her and the six children, he being a rancher, or stockman
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent; health is pretty fair; has 6 children to support; husband has fine health and is a rancher/stockman; mortgaged her allotment along with quarter allotments of three children Frank, Joseph, and Julia; husband bought three whole sections of land in his own name; she has kept taxes paid on all land up to date; has never received any help from the County, State nor the United States Government; allotment is 632.16 acres
